initial.title: [v0.92.1][PROV-C] Production-wire provider and profile hot loading
initial.goal: Production-wire validated provider-instance and inference-profile hot loading without restarting the consuming process.
initial.required_outcome: A provider-only configuration sidecar is watched through the existing reload substrate, accepted candidates atomically replace the active provider snapshot, rejected candidates retain last-known-good, and subsequent production inference consumes the new snapshot.
authority_boundary: Reuse the existing Runtime-kernel watcher and existing provider candidate activation
The watched document is provider-only and cannot grant authority or define executable work
Each inference call retains the immutable provider snapshot selected before dispatch
Credentials remain separately governed references and values are never reload payload
Only later inference consumes an accepted replacement
operator_constraints: Do not build a second watcher or provider registry
Do not reload secrets or authority-bearing objects
Do not implement MLX or OCI packaging
Do not restart the process to claim hot loading
Do not expand into provider architecture redesign
initial.task_boundary: Add one production provider reload owner and connect it to per-step provider resolution in the existing execution runner.
deliverables: Provider-only sidecar validation and atomic snapshot publication
Focused positive negative concurrency and shutdown proof
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A production provider owner starts the existing watcher against an explicit provider-only configuration path
AC-2: A valid provider or profile edit becomes active for subsequent inference without process restart
AC-3: Invalid edits retain the complete last-known-good snapshot with a bounded redacted diagnostic
AC-4: Concurrent readers observe either the old or new complete snapshot and never a partial mixture
AC-5: In-flight inference retains its starting snapshot while later inference consumes the accepted replacement
AC-6: Endpoint model parameter timeout capability and profile changes have focused positive and negative proof
AC-7: Credential values authority objects and executable workflow content are rejected from the provider-only sidecar
AC-8: Unknown mandatory parameters and unsupported capabilities fail closed
AC-9: Debounce duplicate event same-content rapid rewrite and watcher shutdown behavior is proven
AC-10: Exact production call-path formatting lint diff hygiene and independent review pass
non_goals: Reload credentials signing keys database pools authority objects or model weights
Create a second watcher or provider registry
Implement MLX OCI packaging automatic tuning or provider UI
Change an in-flight request after dispatch
initial.plan_summary: Define a provider-only sidecar, reuse the existing watcher and candidate activation, publish immutable last-known-good snapshots, connect per-step production provider resolution, then prove atomicity redaction and shutdown.

steps.action: Define provider-only sidecar validation, snapshot identity, bounded diagnostics, and reload-owner interfaces.
Implement ProviderReloadOwner using the existing watcher and last-known-good candidate activation.
Connect the production execution runner so each inference selects and retains one immutable snapshot.
Add focused parameter capability concurrency redaction debounce and shutdown tests plus operator documentation.
Run focused Rust validation and bounded independent exact-head review.

invariants: No credential values or authority mutation
risks: Testing helper activation without production consumption
Mixing provider changes across one inference call
Leaking secret values in diagnostics or digests
Accepting executable workflow content through the sidecar
stop_conditions: The implementation requires a second watcher or provider registry
A credential value or authority-bearing object enters reload state
Production runner ownership cannot be made explicit
A partial provider snapshot can become visible
Only helper tests exist without production call-path proof

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove valid activation last-known-good retention and the production execution call path with a nonzero exact target.
Prove atomic concurrency parameter capability redaction debounce and shutdown behavior with nonzero focused tests.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on missing production ownership, partial snapshots, invalid-candidate promotion, credential disclosure, authority mutation, restart-based substitution, zero-test selectors, or absent exact-head review.
review_prompts: Does a real production execution path consume the reload owner rather than only helper tests?
Does every inference call retain exactly one immutable starting snapshot?
Can malformed unsupported or secret-bearing candidates ever replace last-known-good state?
Does the implementation reuse the existing watcher and provider registry?
Are accepted and rejected diagnostics bounded and redacted?
initial.review_scope: Provider-only configuration parsing, existing watcher reuse, candidate activation, immutable snapshot ownership, production execution-runner consumption, concurrency, redaction, shutdown, and focused documentation only.
